explanation.owner_view:
Dear Borrower, your construction progress at the 'slab' stage has been verified on-site, and the requested loan tranche release is approved. However, our financial and technical assessment highlights critical funding and contract risks that need your immediate attention.

Key Financial Summary:
- Expected Total Cost to Construct: ₹35,95,326.68
- Sanctioned Loan Amount: ₹25,00,000
- Sanction Gap: ₹-10,95,326.68
- Verified Work Done to Date: ₹17,97,663
- Cumulative Disbursed to Date: ₹12,96,892
- Estimated Cost to Complete: ₹17,97,663
- Cost-to-Complete Gap: ₹-5,94,555

What this means:
Your remaining loan balance is insufficient to complete the construction at current estimated costs, leaving a shortfall of ₹5,94,555. To avoid project stalling later, we strongly advise arranging personal equity or discussing a scope reduction with your contractor.

Key Points to Clarify & Negotiate with Your Contractor:
1. Plinth Beam Concrete Rate: Quoted at ₹9,482/cum (18.0% above the local benchmark of ₹8,036/cum). Ask: 'Could you please provide a rate breakdown for the plinth beam concrete including formwork and grade specifications?'
2. Front-Loaded Payment Schedule: 50.0% of the contract is scheduled before the roof slab is cast, exceeding standard practice of 30.0%. Ask: 'Could we discuss aligning the payment milestones more evenly with physical stage progress on site?'
3. Steel Ratio: The steel density is 78.7 kg/cum (5,132 kg over 65.2 cum RCC), below the standard 80–120 kg/cum range. Ask: 'Could you please confirm if the structural drawings require any additional reinforcement steel for the superstructure framing?'
4. Material Specifications & Brands: Clarify unspecified items including TMT Fe500 brand, vitrified tiles dimensions/series, ceramic dado brand/size, electrical wiring/modular switch brands, CPVC pipe brand/pressure rating, paint brands (interior & exterior), and anti-termite chemical specs/warranty.
explanation.officer_view:
TRANCHE ASSESSMENT REPORT — LOAN ID: 1006

1. Executive Summary & Recommendation:
- Recommendation: RELEASE
- Claimed Stage: slab | Observed Stage: slab (Matches Claim: Yes | Confidence: HIGH | Needs Human Review: False)
- Physical Progress: 50.0% complete

2. Core Financial Metrics:
- Sanctioned Loan Amount: ₹2,500,000
- Cumulative Disbursed: ₹1,296,892
- Expected Total Cost: ₹3,595,326.68
- Completed Value Estimate: ₹8,999,998.91 (Basis: Kompally median, 16 listings)
- Verified Stage Value: ₹1,797,663
- Cost to Complete: ₹1,797,663
- Exposure Ratio: 0.72 (Projected: 0.72) — within acceptable threshold limits
- Live LTV: 14.4% (LTV Default Prior: 0.139)
- Sanction Gap: ₹-1,095,326.68
- Cost-to-Complete Funding Gap: ₹-594,555 (Deficit: Remaining sanction will not cover remaining cost to complete)

3. BOQ & Benchmark Analysis:
- Quoted BOQ Total: ₹2,427,899 (22 line items across Earthwork, Foundation, RCC, Masonry, Plastering, Flooring, Waterproofing, Electrical, Plumbing, Anti-Termite, Painting)
- Fair Price for Quoted Scope: ₹2,420,157.5
- Missing Scope Value: ₹0
- Unpriced/Unbenchmarked Items: Item 18 (Electrical points), Item 19 (CPVC plumbing lines), Item 20 (Anti-termite treatment)
- Benchmark Reference Source: Provisional Hyderabad benchmark schedule / CPWD DSR

4. BOQ & Structural Risk Findings:
- Rate Outlier: Item 6 (Plinth beam concrete M20) quoted at ₹9,482/cum vs benchmark ₹8,036/cum (+18.0% deviation).
- Steel Ratio Risk: 78.7 kg/cum steel-to-concrete ratio (5,132 kg steel / 65.2 cum RCC) vs standard benchmark range of 80–120 kg/cum.
- Front-Loading Risk: 50.0% scheduled milestone disbursement prior to roof slab casting (recommended threshold <= 30.0%).
- Scope Underspecification: Items 10, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21, and 22 lack defined makes, grades, dimensions, or standards.

5. Visual Inspection Evidence:
- Site Photos Reviewed: roof_slab_shuttering_wide.jpg, roof_slab_curing.jpg
- Observations: Vertical columns erected and wrapped for curing; slab shuttering/centering with vertical props and edge formwork fully installed; no external masonry erected.
